title.zh: 軍事工程戰損評估及快速修復設計之可行性評估研究
title.en: Feasibility study on damage assessment and rapid repair design for military engineering

desc.zh: 建立結構戰損評估方法與整合分析平台，並研發快速修復材料與工法。
desc.en: Develops structural damage assessment methods and an integrated analysis platform, with rapid repair materials and methods.

title.zh: 防護設施建置可行性評估與地質調查
title.en: Feasibility assessment and site investigation for a protective facility

desc.zh: 防護設施的建置可行性評估，包含地質調查、防護結構初步規劃、造價與工期研析。
desc.en: Feasibility assessment of a protective facility, covering site investigation, preliminary protective design, cost and schedule.

title.zh: 爆炸衝擊波引致人腦損傷數值模式應用研究
title.en: Numerical modelling of blast-induced brain injury

client.zh: 國防部（與國防醫學大學合作）
client.en: Ministry of National Defense (with National Defense Medical University)

desc.zh: 「探討彈道與爆炸衝擊後頸椎與腦部損傷之綜合評估研究」之子計畫，以人體有限元素模型評估爆震波造成的腦部損傷。
desc.en: Sub-project of an integrated study on cervical spine and brain injury after ballistic and blast impact, using finite-element human body models to assess blast-induced brain injury.

title.zh: 國軍戰力保存之坑道式掩體結構防護研究
title.en: Protective design of tunnel-type shelters for force preservation

desc.zh: 坑道式掩體在爆炸荷載下的結構防護性能分析與設計建議。
desc.en: Structural protection analysis and design recommendations for tunnel-type shelters under blast loading.

title.zh: 提升國軍抗炸掩體防護性能之數值模擬與試驗研究
title.en: Improving the blast protection of military shelters: simulation and testing

desc.zh: 以數值模擬搭配試驗，評估掩體在爆炸荷載下的防護性能並提出改善方向。
desc.en: Combined simulation and testing to evaluate shelter performance under blast loading and propose improvements.

title.zh: 戰時機場跑道緊急搶修技術與材料之研發
title.en: Rapid runway repair techniques and materials

client.zh: 國防部先進科技研究計畫

desc.zh: 研提跑道快速搶修工法，並研發兼顧早期強度、施工性與耐久性的高早強無機聚合修補材料。
desc.en: Developed rapid runway repair methods and high-early-strength geopolymer repair materials balancing early strength, workability and durability.

title.zh: 預鑄纖維強化無機聚合物混凝土防爆版之研發

desc.zh: 與產業共同開發可預鑄的防爆版，並以試驗與數值分析驗證其抗爆性能。
desc.en: Co-developed a precast blast-resistant panel with industry, validated by testing and numerical analysis.
